motor.why: 5203-2402-0001 (vendor), HTD 16T:24T to the flywheel; the squishy wheel geared off the same shaft

angle.why: tips: rigid at the command (floating parts, servo not modelled)

gap.why: POLLEN hood: rigid at the command

variant.label: Topspin turret — full CAD v2
variant.describe: Ben's pie-slice turret, full CAD over the topspin contact parts (ridged squishy 67 mm gap, 112 mm, 1:4 off the flywheel; balls start at rest). 1/4 in plywood side plates tied by spacer tubes; the bore ring + fixed NECTAR rails print carries ears on the ring's outer wall with flaps bolted to the plates' outer faces (3 x M4 each), so the turret holds together without the goBILDA 3208 ring. One-print support deck with guide plates, tilt-servo cradle and idler wall. The static POLLEN hood runs on rollers in the guide plates, pushed by a servo crank and held at POLLEN by a heart-groove latch (horizontal shuttle, gravity-neutral; any push 8.0-9.5 mm latches and releases). The arm: two identical MOD 1 pie slices on the flywheel axle, crossbar, hard stops at +-18 deg, moving NECTAR rail pieces, and the moving POLLEN tips sliding on the arm, set by an arc rail on the hood (no tip servo). Every printed part is one solid and every part is checked to sit on its mount. Structure is drawn only; the physics is the topspin contact model.
